teacherPlayback: Two complete playbacks controlled by the teacher. No student media controls.
scoreRule: 6 objectively scored multiple-choice tasks and 2 teacher-reviewed written tasks, 1 point each. Proposed grade only after both written tasks reviewed.
notes: Language and factual correspondence to the original speech needs direct media review before publication.

objective.q: Who is speaking to the people at the ceremony?
objective.explanation: He is an actor receiving an award.
objective.sourceEvidence: An actor accepts an Academy Award.

objective.q: What do people do while he talks?
objective.explanation: The audience applauds and laughs during the speech.
objective.sourceEvidence: Applause and laughter can be heard.

objective.q: Who is at the ceremony with him?
objective.explanation: He refers to his mother being there.
objective.sourceEvidence: He mentions his mother attending that evening.

objective.q: What feeling does he show towards his family?
objective.explanation: The speech expresses gratitude and affection for family.

objective.q: How many things does he say he needs each day?
objective.explanation: The speech includes a three-part personal framework.
objective.sourceEvidence: He describes three things he needs.

objective.q: What does the speaker hope for his children?
options: That they learn to act tomorrow
That they can feel proud of him
objective.explanation: He says he hopes his children can be proud.
objective.sourceEvidence: The speech includes his hope that his children will be proud.

written.q: Name one family member he talks about.
written.modelAnswer: His mother, his father, his wife or his children.
written.teacherCriterion: Award 1 point for one correctly supported family member.
written.sourceEvidence: The speech mentions several close family members.

written.q: Write one short sentence about his feeling during the speech.
written.modelAnswer: He is happy and grateful for the award.
written.teacherCriterion: Award 1 point for an understandable expression of joy, gratitude or pride.
written.sourceEvidence: The speaker repeatedly thanks people and expresses gratitude.
